completion:
Provide the serial number, model number, and manufacturer of the appliance.
3. Record the date of the test.
4. Detail the specific test or tests that failed.
5. Explain the nature of the failure.
6. Include the pass/fail criteria for each failed test.
7. Include a photograph of fault if accessible.
